summary: A solid colour painted behind the content and padding.
details: It fills the border box by default, so it shows under a dashed border too. A colour with an alpha channel (rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5)) lets whatever is behind show through, without making the content transparent.

values.note: Half-transparent black: the text stays fully opaque.

gotcha: Check contrast: text on a coloured background should be easy to read. A light grey on white or white on orange often fails accessibility guidelines.
